summary: Map banking obligations to controls, evidence and reporting in five days. Explore bank compliance training and build practical review artefacts.
lede: Bank compliance training helps bank compliance officers, legal advisers and operations leads turn banking obligations into assigned oversight and controls. Learners practise building an obligations register, assigning owners, mapping controls to evidence, assessing evidence gaps and preparing a compliance action plan, with focused work on Basel III, regulatory change and digital reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who interpret, oversee or evidence banking obligations in day-to-day work. It suits foundation-level learners who need a practical way to connect requirements, controls and records.
modules: Basel Core Principles and bank perimeter
prerequisites: No prior legal qualification is required. Familiarity with banking products or operations is useful but not essential; coding is not required.
